_comment: Backbone Rule re-wire backlog: live posts that assert external facts without citation, from the 2026-08-30 source audit (business/blog-posts/blog-source-audit-2026-08-30.md). These get re-wired (add sourced backbone + a Sources block + align to current content pillars) ONE AT A TIME through the normal preview -> #tnc-blog-reviews -> Friday cadence gate. NOT auto-executed. DEFERRED until after the first note closes (AJ 2026-08-30) except any marked urgent. When a post is re-wired and re-audits clean, remove it from this list. Ordered by priority.
defer_until: after first note funds/closes (target Sept 2026) — except items marked urgent:true

rewire.why: Asserts 2026 RMD rules + specific tax brackets/thresholds ($ + %) as fact, unverified, zero citations. Wrong/outdated 2026 tax figures under AJ's name = worst-case credibility + compliance error. Bump ahead of the rest.
rewire.source_to: IRS (Pub 590-B, RMD tables, the 2026 inflation-adjustment notice) — verify EVERY figure against IRS, cite inline + Sources block.

rewire.why: 18 external-fact signals (HUD, FHA, CFPB + a 98% figure). Almost entirely HUD/FHA program rules stated with no backing. Highest raw exposure.
